title: Signal Orchestra: Ops Vignettes & Instrumentation Proposals
body:
Purpose:
This doc collects short operational vignettes (real-ish incident sketches), metric definitions tied to those vignettes, tracing/span naming proposals, and a set of compact dashboard widget sketches intended to reduce time-to-diagnosis for the token-serving stack.

Why this format: Drive-first working doc — lightweight, story-driven, and meant to seed a structured metric/trace contract later. Focus is on fast operator workflows (what an engineer needs in the first 5–15 minutes of an incident).

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- Create a small signal set (the "orchestra") per failure mode: latency spikes, KV cold ratio, prefix-mismatch errors, model fallback churn.
- Each signal includes: primary metric (quantile + rate), lightweight trace anchor, short dashboard widget, and simple sampling guidance.
- Prioritize building 6 compact investigation widgets that combine metric + trace link + top-k tenants.

Vignettes (short, scenario-driven):
1) Morning burst: sudden 5–10x increase in 95th TTF (time-to-first-token) across a host pool.
   Observations: high tail on TTF, host CPU steady, KV miss rate up for a subset of tenants, increased cold-start errors from model manager.
   Quick triage path: TTF 95th -> per-host queue depth -> kv-cache-miss-rate per tenant -> trace anchor for first-token path.
   Suggested immediate mitigations: temporary route to warm pool, throttle low-priority tenants, increase sampling of traces for affected tenants.

2) Gradual drift: steady increase in avg tokens per response and slight latency uptick over 24h after a model code change.
   Observations: token distribution shift, batching heuristics mismatch, higher compute time per token.
   Triage: tokens-per-resp cohorted by model-version -> batch size distribution -> kernel selection mismatch logs.
   Instrumentation ask: record tokens-per-response histogram with model_version tag and include kernel selection in trace event.

3) Fallback flapping: repeated fallbacks from quantized model to full-fp model for a subset of requests (30% of requests for tenant X).
   Observations: quality regression detection fires, routing policy flips, throughput thrashes.
   Triage: fallback-rate per route -> per-tenant QoS signal -> trace sample of routing decision span.
   Action: implement circuit break for fallback-churn > threshold and surface tenant in ops panel.

Concrete metric definitions (minimal contract - keep compact):
- ttf_p50 / ttf_p95 / ttf_p99: "time_to_first_token_ms" quantiles (ms), tag keys: model_version, region, tenant_id, host_pool. Window: 1m, 5m aggregate. Owner: runtime-team.
- proc_ms_mean / proc_ms_p95: "compute_time_per_token_ms" (ms per token), tags: model_version, kernel_variant. Window: 5m. Owner: serving-runtime.
- kv_cache_miss_rate: ratio (misses / lookups) over 1m, tags: tenant_id, model_family, cache_tier. Alert threshold: > 2% sustained for 5m for high-volume tenants. Owner: platform-caching.
- prefix_mismatch_rate: number of prefix hashing failures / requests; tags: host, model_version, route. Default sampling: 100% for failed requests. Owner: routing.
- fallback_rate: fraction of requests routed to fallback model variant, tags: route, tenant_id. Window: 1m. Owner: smart-router.
- tokens_per_response_hist: histogram buckets (0-16, 17-64, 65-256, 257-1024), tagged by model_version and prompt_class. Owner: product-infra.
- request_queue_depth: instantaneous gauge per host pool (int). Useful for correlation with latency tails. Owner: infra-sre.

Tracing / span proposals (short anchor rules):
- Root span: "request_receive" (attrs: request_id, tenant_id, route, model_version, region)
- Routing span: "routing.decision" (attrs: decision_reason, fallback, policy_id)
- KV span: "kv.lookup" (attrs: key_hash, cache_tier, hit_bool) -- emit event "kv.evict_hint" when eviction observed
- Kernel span: "kernel.exec" (attrs: kernel_variant, seq_len, token_count) -> include micro-metrics sample (compute_ms)
- First-token anchor: add a tagged event "first_token_emitted" with host_clock and kv_warm_flag to bridge metric -> trace.
Span naming: dotted service.component form to allow query by prefix (eg routing.* and kv.*).
Sampling guidance: increase trace sampling to 5–10% for tenants hitting kv_cache_miss_rate alert; otherwise default 0.5% global. For errors/fallbacks sample 100% of affected traces.

Dashboard sketches (prioritize 6 compact widgets):
1) "Morning pulse" microdash: ttf_p95 (global + per-pool sparkline), top-5 tenants by ttf_p95, count of 500/4xx in last 5m, single-click link to sample traces (filter by tenant).
2) "KV warm index" tile: kv_cache_miss_rate trend + heatmap by tenant (small multiples), per-tenant cold-start count. Drilldown: top keys with high miss rates.
3) "Routing churn" tile: fallback_rate per route (stacked by tenant category), routing-decision error log tail.
4) "Batch mismatch" tile: tokens_per_response histogram with avg batch size overlay, kernel_selection ratio.
5) "Host pressure" tile: request_queue_depth distribution, host-level CPU%, and ongoing evictions.
6) "Investigation quickcard" (single-row): metric summary snapshot + top trace sample ids + suggested next steps.

Widget design constraints:
- All tiles must show a 1m / 5m toggle and include the top-3 tags as selectors.
- Each tile should add a single-click "trace sample" action that opens the first-token anchored trace with pre-applied filters.
- Keep panel query cost in mind: use pre-aggregated quantiles for ttf and precomputed heatmap indexes for per-tenant kv misses.

Alerting recommendations (guide, not final):
- High-severity: ttf_p99 > X ms AND kv_cache_miss_rate > 3% sustained 3m -> Pager.
- Medium: ttf_p95 > Y ms for >= 10% of tenants -> Paged to oncall with runbook link.
- Low: small increases in tokens_per_response leading to batch regressions -> ticket to product-infra.

Runbook snippets (first-10-min checklist):
- Confirm scope: global vs tenant-scoped (query request_count by tenant_id).
- If KV miss-driven: check eviction logs and top keys; optionally pin top-10 keys for hot tenants.
- If routing/fallback-driven: inspect routing.decision spans and policy table; temporarily pin to stable model_version.
- If host pressure: drain a host from pool and re-route to preserve latency SLOs.

Data cost / query budget notes: 
- Pre-aggregate and store quantiles at 1m resolution; avoid live-quantile scans on dashboards.
- Limit per-tenant heatmap resolution to top-200 tenants by QPS; use sampling for the rest.

Open questions / items to scope:
- Which team owns the pre-aggregate pipeline for ttf quantiles? (proposal: serving-runtime but need infra commit).
- How should we surface tenant-priority tiers in dashboard filters? (prod/paid/dev).
- Should prefix_mismatch_rate be normalized per route complexity?
- Determine concrete numeric thresholds for pager vs page-to-channel (ask SRE leads).

Next steps & owners (short):
- Build 6 widgets as a dashboard prototype (owner: Liam O'Connor) — deadline: 2025-09-09
- Implement trace sampling tweaks and first-token event emitter (owner: Diego Morales) — deadline: 2025-09-12
- Convene metric contract sync for ttf quantiles (owner: Ava Chen) — meeting: 2025-09-05

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Could we build a "one-click-circuit-breaker" control for high fallback churn in the ops panel? Nice but prod-risky.
- Consider small synthetic probes that emulate tenant cohort distribution to validate kv warm index.

References & links:
- Incident replay notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Incident+Replays
- Metric registry starter: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/blob/main/metric_registry.md
- Routing policy service docs (internal): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Routing/Policy+Engine

If you read this and want a different framing (checklist-first, or incident-vignette-first), thumbs up. I'll convert the agreed pieces into a compact metric contract doc and open a PR for dashboard scaffolding.

-- Ava
